subject: Decision: consolidate to 1 multi-task model + 2 legacy classifiers
body:
Team,

Decision for the 7/9 launch review: we ship the consolidated BAM model replacing 9 of 11 classifiers, and keep dedicated classifiers for intent disambiguation and sarcasm. Rafael's teacher-annealing recovered about half the gap but not enough to bet those surfaces on it.

The economics still land: serving footprint drops ~70%, and version management goes from eleven release trains to three. Q3 OKR (already locked) covers the remaining two tasks via targeted data collection.

For the review: Linnea owns the eval appendix, Maren please include the de-dup contamination stats - the 3% cross-task near-dupe finding is exactly the kind of rigor LRB likes, and other teams should hear it too.

Nadia, we're confirmed for the 7/9 slot per your note.

Thanks all,
Priya
